name: @khorsheed/dsh-video-suite
description: Mode bundle 剪辑模式: the dsh-video agent preset plus the video studio it grants — podcast and conversation editing, speakers found in one mixed recording, cut by deleting words — in one install. Thin meta package: a patch carrying the member's canonical row and the mode's preset row, an npm dependency on the member, locale card metadata — no runtime code, no client half.

compat.notes: Pure composition: the bundle mounts the member's canonical row plus the dsh-video preset row and registers nothing of its own. The floor is the higher of the member's (0.1.5-rc.1 — video-studio) and the preset row's floor: an `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` declaration exists only on host 0.1.7-rc.1 and later. Member behavior details live in the member's own dsh.compat.
